roadmap.title: Start beach and first overworld
roadmap.description: Take the stick, die once, and enter the start-area codes. Kill enemies for about 100 gold so you can make an offering at a shrine. Keep any golden coin for a wishing well.

roadmap.title: Frog's Domain and Ruined Atoll
roadmap.description: Collect bombs in Frog's Domain and take the magic orb. Pray at an obelisk.

roadmap.title: Mountain door and Quarry
roadmap.description: Open the mountain gate and take the gun in the Quarry before you ever pick up the sword. Beat the scavenger boss in the Rooted Ziggurat.

roadmap.title: Beneath the Well, Dark Tomb and West Garden
roadmap.description: Get the ice bomb, then the sword in West Garden. Ring the west bell and keep cutting grass.

roadmap.title: East Forest, Eastern Vault and Library
roadmap.description: Ring the east bell, freeze the slime for the treasure, and beat the Siege Engine and the Librarian.

roadmap.title: Sealed Temple
roadmap.description: Place the three keys in the Sealed Temple.

roadmap.title: Swamp, Cathedral and spirit realm
roadmap.description: As a spirit, push the skulls in the Swamp and clear the Cathedral challenges for the air dash.

roadmap.title: Restoring stats and finishing
roadmap.description: Pray at all six Hero's Graves, collect the leftover pages, fairies, coins and effigies, then finish the Heir fight and the dash treasures.

achievements.description: Pick up the stick from the chest at the start.
achievements.summary: Pick up the stick from the chest at the start.

steps.text: Go forward from the start, enter the lit doorway on the left, and open the chest to take the stick.

achievements.description: Pick up the sword.
achievements.summary: Pick up the sword.

guide.context: Take the gun first if you want the gun-before-sword achievement. Once you hold the sword, that one needs a new file.

steps.text: In @loc{West Garden}, stand in front of the door under the bridge and enter Down, Left, Up, Right, Up, Left on the D-pad. Open the chest inside for the sword.

achievements.description: Die once and reach the character waiting in spirit form.
achievements.summary: Die once and reach the character waiting in spirit form.

guide.context: Slimes near the start beach are an easy way to die.

steps.text: Let an enemy defeat you. Wake as a spirit and follow the only path to the waiting character.

achievements.description: Rang the Eastern Bell
achievements.summary: Ring the Eastern Bell.

steps.text: Beat @loc{Guard House 1} in the East Forest, then hit the golden bell at the forest entrance with your weapon.

achievements.description: Rang the Western Bell
achievements.summary: Ring the Western Bell.

steps.text: Cross @loc{Beneath the Well} and the docks, then climb the ladder in @loc{West Garden}.
Defeat the boss at the top.
Hit the Western Bell with your weapon.

achievements.description: Pray at an obelisk to activate it.
achievements.summary: Pray at an obelisk to activate it.

guide.context: Two early ones are the obelisk near the end of @loc{Beneath the Well} and the one in the @loc{Ruined Atoll}.

steps.text: Stand on an obelisk's rune and hold the roll button (A or Space) for about 3 seconds without moving.

achievements.description: Burn an upgrade item at a fox shrine.
achievements.summary: Burn an upgrade item at a fox shrine.

guide.context: Keep about 100 gold, which is what the first offering costs.

steps.text: Stand next to a fox shrine, open the inventory, and burn an upgrade component (lower right). You need some gold.

achievements.description: Found the red key
achievements.summary: Defeat the Siege Engine boss in the Eastern Vault Fortress.

steps.text: Fight through the @loc{Eastern Vault Fortress} and defeat the @enemy{Siege Engine}.

achievements.description: Found the green key
achievements.summary: Defeat the Librarian boss in the Library.

steps.text: Go through @loc{Ruined Atoll} to the @loc{Library} and defeat the @enemy{Librarian} at the top.

achievements.displayName: At The Root of The World
achievements.description: Found the blue key
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss that guards the end of the Rooted Ziggurat.

steps.text: Cross the @loc{Quarry} into the @loc{Rooted Ziggurat} and defeat the @enemy{Scavenger Boss} at its end.

achievements.description: Place the three boss keys in the Sealed Temple.
achievements.summary: Place the three boss keys in the Sealed Temple.

steps.text: Defeat the three gem bosses so you hold all three keys.
Ring both bells so the golden door of the @loc{Sealed Temple} opens.
Put the three keys in the three slots of the mechanism inside.

achievements.description: Beat all 6 Cathedral statue challenges to get the air dash.
achievements.summary: Beat all 6 Cathedral statue challenges to get the air dash.

steps.text: Place the three keys in the @loc{Sealed Temple}, then enter the middle teleporter in the hub and talk to the fox. You lose this fight and wake as a spirit.
As a spirit, go into the @loc{Cathedral} and ride the elevator down to the main room.
Climb down the ladder at the altar.
Beat all 6 challenges (statue fights) to receive the air dash.

achievements.description: Pray at all six Hero's Graves to restore your body.
achievements.summary: Pray at all six Hero's Graves to restore your body.

guide.context: You need the air dash. All six work at night. Sleep in a bed afterward to get back to daytime.

collectibles.name: East Forest grave
collectibles.location: Far right corner of the temple-like structure in front of the teleporter
collectibles.method: Pray to get your strength back.

collectibles.name: Library grave
collectibles.location: Main hall of the @loc{Library}
collectibles.method: Defeat the two guardians to reveal the tomb, then pray for mana.

collectibles.name: Eastern Vault grave
collectibles.location: Outside, east on the ground floor, far right
collectibles.method: Pray to restore your HP.

collectibles.name: Monastery grave
collectibles.location: @loc{Monastery} in the Quarry
collectibles.method: Go to the tomb, return to trigger a fight, beat the enemy, then pray for your potions.

collectibles.name: West Garden grave
collectibles.location: West Garden
collectibles.method: Pray to restore your defense.

collectibles.name: Swamp grave
collectibles.location: Outside the @loc{Cathedral}
collectibles.method: Pray to restore your stamina.

achievements.description: Defeat the Heir without having every manual page.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Heir without having every manual page.

guide.context: You can still get this after the true ending by reloading the old save, since New Game+ starts in a new slot.

steps.text: After you hold the air dash and have restored your body, return to the hub and enter the middle teleporter.
Talk to the fox and defeat the Heir while you are still missing manual pages.
If you already hold every page, attack the Heir instead of talking to her. This starts the same fight.
When the game offers New Game+ or Retry, choose Retry.

achievements.description: Find all 28 sets of manual pages.
achievements.summary: Find all 28 sets of manual pages.

guide.context: Pages come in pairs on facing sheets, plus the cover with page 1.

collectibles.name: Pages 2/3
collectibles.location: Start plate
collectibles.method: Stand on the first golden plate and hold the roll button for 3 seconds.

collectibles.name: Pages 32/33
collectibles.location: Under the start-area bridge, beach
collectibles.method: Walk behind the waterfall to the left of the bridge.

collectibles.name: Pages 16/17
collectibles.location: Golden plate below the west windmill
collectibles.method: Walk onto the plate.

collectibles.name: Pages 18/19
collectibles.location: Behind the windmill
collectibles.method: Take the page beside the entrance to @loc{Beneath the Well}.

collectibles.name: Pages 28/29

collectibles.method: Cut through the trees with the sword.

collectibles.name: Pages 22/23
collectibles.location: Stone head island above the East Forest entrance
collectibles.method: Dash into the statue's mouth. The shopkeeper inside gives the page.

collectibles.name: Pages 34/35

collectibles.method: The page is on the floor below as you enter.

collectibles.name: Pages 30/31
collectibles.location: End of the area by the save shrine
collectibles.method: Beat the guards, then unlock the gate next to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Pages 26/27
collectibles.location: Narrow path north of the save shrine
collectibles.method: Go north after the first Chompignon.

collectibles.name: Pages 46/47
collectibles.location: Behind the island past the ice dagger area
collectibles.method: Power the obelisk near the fox shrine as a spirit, teleport away and back, then dash across the pillars behind the island.

collectibles.method: Take the page at the forest entrance.

collectibles.name: Pages 14/15
collectibles.location: Golden plate in the forest
collectibles.method: Walk onto the plate.

collectibles.name: Pages 6/7
collectibles.location: Fortress entrance
collectibles.method: Pray at the obelisk blocking the path. The page is behind it.

collectibles.name: Pages 36/37
collectibles.location: Balcony above the fox obelisk room
collectibles.method: Take the far left walkway on the upper level.

collectibles.name: Pages 38/39
collectibles.location: Laboratory above the book stack
collectibles.method: Smash the glass cases.

collectibles.name: Pages 40/41
collectibles.location: Laboratory above the book stack
collectibles.method: Smash the glass cases.

collectibles.name: Pages 50/51
collectibles.location: Laboratory above the book stack
collectibles.method: Smash the glass cases.

collectibles.name: Pages 24/25
collectibles.location: Upper level, north-east ledge
collectibles.method: Walk the inside edge to the ledge.

collectibles.name: Pages 48/49
collectibles.location: Golden tablet with two grapple points before the snowy mountain
collectibles.method: Trace it on the D-pad: U L D R D L U R.

collectibles.name: Pages 20/21
collectibles.location: Top of the map in front of the locked gate
collectibles.method: Walk up to the gate.

collectibles.name: Cover and page 1
collectibles.location: Behind the mountain gate
collectibles.method: Collect every other page first. Then stand at the gate and input: U L D L U L D L U R U R U L U R D R U L U L U R U L D L U R U U L U R D R D R U R D L D R U R R D R U R D R U R R D L D L D R D R D L L D R D L D R U R D R U R R D D L U R U L D L U L U L U R R U L U.

achievements.description: Free at least one fairy.
achievements.summary: Free at least one fairy.

guide.context: U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right. Any of the 20 fairies counts, and the full list is in the Spring Falls checklist.

steps.text: On the south island under the right end of the bridge, stand by the big pink flower and input U R D L D L D L D L U on the D-pad.
Open the fairy chest that appears.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 1, Mr Mayor.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 1, Mr Mayor.

guide.context: U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad.

steps.text: Use the key found near the west windmill to open the door above the first stairs in the east building.
Inside, trace the groove pattern on the wall: L U R U L D L U R D R U L U R D.
Walk the path that opens and take the treasure from the chest.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 2, A Secret Legend.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 2, A Secret Legend.

guide.context: Part 1 works at night or as a spirit. Part 2 needs the restored body so you can change the time of day. U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Cathedral} as a spirit or at night. Take the first door on the left.
Push the wall where the bone ladder rests. Then push the wall behind the chest you find.
At the back door, input L U L U R U L U R D R R U R D L D R D L D L.
After your body is restored, sleep in a bed to make it day.
Return the same way. The chest is no longer blocked. Open it.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 3, Sacred Geometry.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 3, Sacred Geometry.

guide.context: U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad.

steps.text: Stand in front of the west windmill and input D L L U U R R L D R U D on the D-pad.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 4, Vintage.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 4, Vintage.

guide.context: D, R and L mean Down, Right and Left on the D-pad.

steps.text: Wade to the island with the gold tail-shaped stand by the south beach and stand in the shallow water.
Enter D, then R 11 times, then L 12 times.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 5, Just Some Pals.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 5, Just Some Pals.

steps.text: In the @loc{Swamp} burying ground, find the four skulls. One is behind a gravestone, so tilt the camera.
Push all four into the small pool in front of the grave that has a skull on top.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 6, Regal Weasel.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 6, Regal Weasel.

guide.context: If the slime dies first, pray at a shrine to reset the area.

steps.text: Equip the magic dagger, magic wand, and magic orb.
In @loc{Lower East Forest}, use the dagger and wand together on the slime on the cliff to freeze it.
Grapple the frozen slime with the orb to reach the ledge and open the chest.

achievements.description: Free all 20 fairies, then open the chest in the fairy fountain room.
achievements.summary: Free all 20 fairies, then open the chest in the fairy fountain room.

guide.context: Each fairy chest opens when you trace a pattern on the D-pad at its spot. U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad. Freeing 10 fairies gives pages 54/55. After all 20, open the chest in the fairy fountain, found past the waterfall beside the @loc{Dark Tomb}.

collectibles.location: Lower level of the second obelisk room

collectibles.name: Fox statue
collectibles.location: First temple room under the statue with three foxes
collectibles.method: Trace the floor tiles. Input: U R U L U R U L U R D R U U L.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 8, Power Up.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 8, Power Up.

guide.context: U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad.

steps.text: Stand by the wind chime outside the old house under the west windmill and input U D R U D L U D L R D L R U on the D-pad.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 9, Back to Work.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 9, Back to Work.

guide.context: U/D/L/R mean Up, Down, Left, Right on the D-pad.

steps.text: Stand on the first golden plate where you start and input R D L U L L D R R D D on the D-pad.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 10, Phonomath.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 10, Phonomath.

guide.context: You need the air dash.

steps.text: In the @loc{Ruined Atoll}, go left to the spot where a rune is cut. Dash across the water gap to the brick walkway on the far side and follow it to the chest.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 11, Dusty.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 11, Dusty.

guide.context: You need the air dash.

steps.text: Near the Hero's Grave outside the @loc{Eastern Vault}, dash across the rubble to the cave on the north side.
Break all four piles of leaves to make the chest appear, then open it.

achievements.description: Open secret treasure 12, Forever Friend.
achievements.summary: Open secret treasure 12, Forever Friend.

guide.context: You need the air dash.

steps.text: In the teleporter hub, find the concealed route linking the main teleporters with the lone southern one.
Dash west along it to the chest.

achievements.description: Cut 1000 pieces of grass with the sword.
achievements.summary: Cut 1000 pieces of grass with the sword.

guide.context: The counter keeps running through the game, so you will reach it in normal play.

steps.text: Cut grass with the sword whenever you pass it until it unlocks.

achievements.description: Hold 10 effigies at once without using any.
achievements.summary: Hold 10 effigies at once without using any.

guide.context: 12 effigies exist and you need to hold any 10 at once. Do not use or break any. If you do, you can still earn this in New Game+ by carrying over items and collecting what is missing.

collectibles.method: Open the chest.

achievements.description: Throw a golden coin into a wishing well.
achievements.summary: Throw a golden coin into a wishing well.

steps.text: Take a golden coin from a chest. The first one is in a secret room behind trees in the overworld.
Stand at a wishing well, equip the golden coin, and throw it in.

achievements.description: Throw 15 golden coins into wishing wells in one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Throw 15 golden coins into wishing wells in one playthrough.

guide.context: 15 coins sit in chests across the world. They do not need to go into one well or all at once. Coins already thrown do not carry into New Game+.

collectibles.name: Dash cliff

achievements.description: Perform the roll attack with the sword.
achievements.summary: Perform the roll attack with the sword.

guide.context: You need the sword first.

steps.text: Press the sword button and the roll button at the same time while moving.

achievements.displayName: Bring it to the wrong fight
achievements.description: Pick up the gun before you pick up the sword.
achievements.summary: Pick up the gun before you pick up the sword.

guide.context: Easier with No Fail Mode and unlimited stamina turned on. Taking the sword first means starting a new file.

steps.text: Open the mountain gate, then take the back path to the @loc{Quarry}.
Take the hidden passage to the plateau with the gun and pick it up.
Do not take the sword before this.

achievements.description: Freeze yourself with an ice bomb.
achievements.summary: Freeze yourself with an ice bomb.

guide.context: Only an ice bomb works. The magic wand and dagger do not count.

steps.text: Open the chest in @loc{Beneath the Well} that holds an @item{ice bomb}.
Throw it at a wall and stay inside the blast so you freeze.

achievements.description: Use 10 bombs and rest at a shrine.
achievements.summary: Use 10 bombs and rest at a shrine.

guide.context: Any bomb type counts. The bonus bombs return each time you rest afterward.

steps.text: Collect bombs in @loc{Frog's Domain}.
Use 10 bombs.
Rest at a fox shrine.
